question: What Are the 5 PLC Programming Languages?
body_html:
PLC programming languages are defined by IEC 61131-3, which specifies five languages, each suited to a different kind of problem.

LanguageTypeBest For
Ladder Diagram (LD)GraphicalDiscrete I/O, relay replacement
Function Block Diagram (FBD)GraphicalPID loops, signal conditioning
Sequential Function Chart (SFC)GraphicalBatch, machine cycles
Structured Text (ST)TextComplex calculations, data handling
Instruction List (IL)TextLow level, assembly style code

Ladder is the most widely used in discrete manufacturing, while Structured Text is the fastest growing.
